Name: Alt Textures for MissAnaira's Star Crops
Author: kenopsiatennine
Description:
This is a very simple mod for a mod, a retexture of the galaxy trees, fruit, and sapling items from Star Crops. All other sprites in the Objects.png sheet are MissAnaira's originals.

To install manually:

Go to the Star Crops mod folder (Most likely location C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\StarCrops ) and replace the Objects.png and the fruitTrees.png files in the assets folder with the ones in the zip file.

To install through Vortex:

Open Vortex, go to Star Crops, click the down arrow next to the 'Remove' button, go to 'open in file manager', open the StarCrops folder, and continue as above. 

Thanks to MissAnaira for allowing me to make and post this retexture!
